value.rationale: The pair/triple incidence is a natural first asymmetric fixed-uniformity disjointness class. The theorem gives the complete optimal realizable online mistake complexity for every n, an all-order universal ceiling five, and the exact first ground order ten attaining it, with explicit optimal trees. It distinguishes adaptive behavior from the established symmetric pair/pair rank-four ceiling and closes a natural exact-invariant gap rather than reporting an arbitrary isolated computation.
